refnamediv.refpurpose: Gets the keys of the attached iterators

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
public arrayMultipleIterator::key
Gets the current keys of all attached iterators, by calling Iterator::key on each valid one.
With MultipleIterator::MIT_KEYS_NUMERIC, the keys are listed in the order in which the iterators were attached. With MultipleIterator::MIT_KEYS_ASSOC, they are keyed by the information associated with each iterator by MultipleIterator::attachIterator.
